root_cause: Authenticated immutable Netlify deploy hook recorded one real 502. GitHub later polled the same persisted failed proof thirty times; this was not thirty independent failed tenant API calls. Gateway error handling collapsed HTTP/network/shape/tenant failures into generic 502 and discarded the pre-existing finite Edge stage source.
intervention: Reuse existing tenant-bound gateway and classify only finite HTTP status and known Edge read-stage labels in server-only logs. Neither customer identity nor upstream body, credentials or query text appear in logs; preserve auth, response codes, cache and scheduler.
prevention: Require server-only allowlisted failures, tenant-shape fail-closed, signed immutable production evidence and two distinct tenant end-to-end acceptance. Do not equate post-deploy repeated status polling with independent HTTP requests.
